causes.label: Morning sickness
causes.safetyNote: If you cannot keep fluids down for a day, are losing weight, or feel faint, call your midwife or doctor. Sickness in pregnancy can get serious and there is treatment for it.

causes.label: Vertigo / dizziness
causes.safetyNote: New, severe or one-sided spinning is worth a doctor's opinion rather than an app's.

modes.blurb: An unhurried, regular tap you can rest your attention on while a wave passes. Nudge the level until it is clear but not annoying.
modes.tagline: A steady tap on the inside of your wrist
modes.title: Pulse

modes.blurb: Your watch taps the rhythm so you can keep your eyes shut: a long tap in, a longer one out. Breathing out for longer than you breathe in is the whole technique.
modes.evidenceNote: Trials of slow diaphragmatic breathing during chemotherapy and after surgery have reported lower nausea scores. The studies are small.
modes.tagline: Slow the breath, paced by your wrist
modes.title: Breathe

modes.blurb: A pure 100 Hz tone at a low volume. Headphones, one minute, eyes wherever you like.
modes.evidenceNote: A 2025 Nagoya University study is titled "Just 1-min exposure to a pure tone at 100 Hz with daily exposable sound pressure levels may improve motion sickness".
modes.tagline: A 100 Hz tone through your headphones
modes.title: Tone

modes.blurb: The inside of the wrist, three finger-widths below the crease, between the two tendons. Press with your thumb, or line up the stud on a band you already own.
modes.evidenceNote: Pressure at this spot has been trialled for travel, post-surgery and pregnancy sickness. The Cochrane review of early-pregnancy trials calls the evidence limited and inconsistent.
modes.tagline: Find the spot a band sits on, and hold it
modes.title: Press
